source_applicability.scope: Source applicability is not compiled validity, numerical equivalence or performance evidence.

recommended_gates: Adopt the amendment: strictly positive aggregate and median paired gain; at least 13/16 strict positive pairs with ties as nonwins; positive median in every block and both order strata. Preserve all full non-timing/state/config/stopping/checkpoint exactness and the conjunctive fixture guard (>3% median slowdown AND at least 9/16 paired slowdowns >3%). No minimum percentage or calibrated confidence claim.
finalization_hold: Root must explicitly adopt the amendment and supersede v1 minimum 1%/0.5% gates and nominal-alpha fields in the eventual executable protocol; frozen historical files remain untouched.
Choose ordering policy once and freeze the complete explicit balanced schedule before execution. If randomizing, record seed/algorithm and do not reroll.
Wait for E037 outcome. If it qualifies, reconsider baseline and source applicability, especially E036 subsumption, before any small-gain source/build freeze.
Fresh source archives, reviews, unit/build provenance and separate root runtime authorization remain required. A screen pass only advances to separately authorized broader qualification.
caveats: Old samples selected these four hypotheses but must contribute zero new decision samples; preserve every candidate outcome and the four-candidate selection history.
No pooling, replacements, exclusions, optional stopping, extensions, candidate stacking or outcome-driven metric changes.
Positive-only gates can admit tiny systematic bias; 13/16 signs and block/order consistency do not establish independence or calibrated statistical confidence.

Real small gains can fail finite-sample consistency rules. Report absolute milliseconds, unrounded gains, all pairs, win/tie/loss counts, block/order summaries, ranges and median absolute deviation as descriptive evidence.
E037 retains its unchanged 2% primary gate; this design does not reopen or revise historical rejected outcomes.

official_reference.scope: Blocking/randomization rationale only; not a guarantee for serial GPU measurements.
